hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); [ -z "$cmd" ] && exit 0; case "$cmd" in cd\ *|ls|ls\ *|pwd|echo\ *|cat\ *|mv\ *|cp\ *|mkdir\ *|touch\ *|git\ status*|git\ add*|git\ diff*|git\ log*|git\ branch*|git\ show*) exit 0 ;; esac; reason=$(claude -p "In 15 words or fewer, plainly explain what this shell command will do. No preamble, no quotes: $cmd" --permission-mode plan 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$reason" ] && exit 0; jq -n --arg r "$reason" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:$r}}'
